    df_photos = pd.DataFrame(photo_records)
    # Keep top results by distance (most relevant photos)
    if not df_photos.empty:
        distance_threshold = df_photos['photo_distance'].quantile(0.5)
        df_photos = df_photos[df_photos['photo_distance'] <= distance_threshold]
    print(f"Found {len(df_photos)} relevant seafood platter/oyster photos.")
except Exception as e:

    conn_photo = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_paths['photo'])
    placeholders2 = ','.join(['?' for _ in businesses_with_fresh_tips])
    query_photo = f"""
        SELECT business_id, photo_id, label, caption
        FROM photo
        WHERE business_id IN ({placeholders2})
          AND (LOWER(caption) LIKE '%seafood%' OR LOWER(caption) LIKE '%oyster%'
               OR LOWER(caption) LIKE '%platter%' OR LOWER(label) LIKE '%food%')
    """
    df_photos = pd.read_sql_query(query_photo, conn_photo, params=businesses_with_fresh_tips)
    df_photos['photo_distance'] = 0.0
    conn_photo.close()
